items.quote: Er muss innerhalb eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift beim Bezirksamt Beispielbek, Marktplatz am Bach 1, 22081 Hamburg erhoben werden.
items.computation: 1) Letter is dated 19.11.2026 (Thursday); no separate 'Aufgabe zur Post' (dispatch) date is given, so the dispatch date is assumed to equal the letter date, 19.11.2026. 2) The letter itself states the delivery-fiction rule: a simple letter is deemed received on the 4th day after dispatch (§ 41 Abs. 2 HmbVwVfG as cited). Counting from the day after dispatch (20.11 = day 1, 21.11 = day 2, 22.11 = day 3, 23.11 = day 4), the decision is deemed delivered (Bekanntgabe) on Monday, 23.11.2026. 3) Per § 31 Abs. 1 HmbVwVfG in conjunction with § 187 Abs. 1 BGB, the day of the triggering event (23.11.2026) is not counted; the one-month period therefore starts running on 24.11.2026. 4) Per § 188 Abs. 2 BGB, a one-month period ends on the day of the last month that bears the same number as the day of the triggering event (23), i.e. 23.12.2026. 5) 23.12.2026 is a Wednesday and not a public holiday in Hamburg, so no weekend/holiday shift applies.

warnings: The exact 'Aufgabe zur Post' (dispatch) date is not stated in the letter; the deadline computation assumes dispatch occurred on the letter date (19.11.2026). If the letter was actually mailed later, the Widerspruch deadline of 23.12.2026 shifts accordingly.

The letter cites a '4th day after posting' delivery fiction, which differs from the commonly known federal rule of the 3rd day (§ 41 Abs. 2 VwVfG) — this is taken at face value as the applicable Hamburg provision (§ 41 Abs. 2 HmbVwVfG) referenced in the letter.
